name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Hub USB sources with HFS+ support and rekordbox names/colors.
description: Connect up to eight USB sticks through a hub, including HFS+ rekordbox exports. USB numbers follow hub ports; native sources appear first, then hub sources in numeric order. Shows rekordbox names/colors and analyzed waveforms. Press USB STOP to select a stick or hold to eject the hub; wait for confirmation. Experimental Ethernet PRO DJ LINK sharing; actual CDJs and Wi-Fi sharing remain unvalidated. Large libraries may exceed sharing catalog limits. Exact firmware 2.00 ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel 4.4.194; core >=1.2.3.
